name: Wen Junsheng
current_role: One of the 10 actual controllers (Wen family concert group) of Wens Foodstuff Group (300498.SZ)
profile: Wen Junsheng (温均生) is a member of the founding Wen family behind Wens Foodstuff Group, China's large pig/poultry producer founded by his father Wen Beifen in 1983. He remains on the 10-person actual-controller group named under the family's renewed concert-party agreement (2025), per the company's 2026 interim report.
interesting_fact: Per Jiemian, he is Wen Beifen's eldest son and the father of Wen Jiaolong, the first third-generation family member added as an actual controller and to the Wens board.
notes: No personal profile/executive post found; low public profile. Approach via Wens board secretary office (dsh@wens.com.cn, tel published 0766-2292926). Alive status not explicitly confirmed, but listed as controller in Aug 2026 filing.

name: Xu Xizhong
current_role: Former chairman and actual controller of Hubei Sanxia New Building Materials (600293.SH); current post unknown
profile: Xu Xizhong (许锡忠) controlled Shanghai-listed float-glass maker Sanxia New Materials (三峡新材), together with his vehicle Hainan Zong Xuan Da Industrial Investment (海南宗宣达实业), and chaired its board; the company also owned mobile-phone distributor Shenzhen Hengbo. By 2025 the company was controlled by Dangyang City Investment and chaired by Xie Pule.
interesting_fact: In 2019 he chaired Sanxia New Materials while also chairing Shenzhen Weikangde Investment Group, Jiangxi Chaosheng Mining and Hainan Zong Xuan Da Industrial Investment, per the company's 2019 annual report.
deep_cut_fact: His career began as a department manager at a garment factory in Laowu township, Chaoyang county, Guangdong; he later ran a restaurant (Haomen Yeda Jiulou) in Puning as general manager before becoming chairman of Shenzhen Xinzhen Co.
notes: Hurun listing only 2017. He has since lost control of Sanxia New Materials (now state-controlled) and his shares were frozen in 2019 litigation; a Dec 2025 SSE regulatory warning named him as former chairman. Likely no longer UHNW and not a good outreach target; no published contact found.

name: Olga Polizzi
current_role: Deputy Chairman and Director of Design, Rocco Forte Hotels; owner of The Polizzi Collection (Hotel Tresanton, Hotel Endsleigh, The Star)
profile: Olga Polizzi CBE (b. 1946), daughter of Charles Forte, is a British hotelier and interior designer who co-founded Rocco Forte Hotels with her brother Sir Rocco Forte, where she is deputy chairman and design director. She also owns The Polizzi Collection: Hotel Tresanton in Cornwall (bought 1998), Hotel Endsleigh in Devon (2004) and The Star in Alfriston, Sussex.
interesting_fact: She joined the family business only after her first husband died, starting in Forte's design department where budgets were so tight 'we couldn't spend more than £8 on a metre of fabric'.
deep_cut_fact: As a teenager she and Rocco worked at the airport making sandwiches, and she also worked in the Café Royal kitchens; a keen gardener, she opens her Sussex garden every year for the local hospice and hospital. She calls herself 'a complete Eeyore' next to her optimistic brother.

public_contacts.value: sophie@thepolizzicollection.com (Sophie Grounds, Director of Communications, The Polizzi Collection)

notes: Also a former Conservative Westminster councillor (Lancaster Gate). Mother of TV's 'Hotel Inspector' Alex Polizzi. Best route: Polizzi Collection comms director.

name: Zeng Hui
current_role: Co-founder and ~18.85% shareholder (one of the controlling shareholders) of Suzhou Secote Precision Electronic (603283.SH)
profile: Zeng Hui (曾慧, b. 1977) co-founded Suzhou Secote Precision Electronic in 2007 with Sun Feng; the Shanghai-listed company makes automated/intelligent manufacturing and inspection equipment for consumer-electronics makers. She served as general manager from 2015 and remains a top shareholder, directly holding 18.85% as of Feb 2026.
interesting_fact: Secote's 36Kr company profile lists her as founder and general manager with a junior-college (dazhuan) education, building the company from a 2007 startup into a listed automation-equipment maker.
deep_cut_fact: Before founding Secote she did sales work at Shanghai Liangrui Electronics (1999-2002) and then was deputy general manager of Yanling Automation Equipment Factory in Suzhou's Wuzhong Economic Development Zone (2002-2007).
notes: Feb 2026 SSE filing confirms her 18.85% stake (https://static.cninfo.com.cn/finalpage/2026-02-28/1224987773.PDF); an Aug 2025 company notice mentions her separately from directors/officers, so she may no longer hold an executive post. No published personal contact; route via Secote board office.

name: Huang Jiadi
current_role: Chairman and President, Royal Group Co. (皇氏集团, formerly Huangshi Dairy; 002329.SZ), Nanning, Guangxi
profile: Huang Jiadi (黄嘉棣, b. 1962) is founder-chairman and controlling shareholder of Royal Group, a Guangxi dairy company built around buffalo milk that listed in Shenzhen in 2010. In July 2026 he agreed to sell ~5.8% to a Shenzhen green/low-carbon investment partnership, keeping ~20% and control.
interesting_fact: He has positioned the company around buffalo milk; in a Feb 2026 interview he cited a dairy-buffalo germplasm 'chip' breakthrough and the birth of a calf from embryos imported from Pakistan.
deep_cut_fact: A Guangxi University graduate and senior engineer, he started as an engineer at the Guangxi Architectural Comprehensive Design Institute and was development manager at the Shenzhen Shatoujiao Free Trade Zone development company before dairy; he is a three-term president of the Guangxi Dairy Association.
notes: Company has an agrivoltaics (农光互补) buffalo-farm project in Binyang county, which may interest an energy podcast. Company and he received regulatory warning letters over disclosure (2023-2024). Also president of the Shanghai Guangxi Chamber of Commerce and CKGSB Guangxi alumni association.

name: Josette Ades
current_role: Private investor; directly holds ~6.4% (8.1M Class A shares) of Organogenesis Holdings (NASDAQ: ORGO)
profile: Josette Ades is the spouse of Alan A. Ades, co-founder of Canton, Massachusetts regenerative-medicine/wound-care company Organogenesis Holdings. A June 2025 Schedule 13D/A lists her as directly owning 8,112,497 ORGO shares (~6.4%); the founding Ades/Erani/Nussdorf holders then said they no longer act as a 'group'.
interesting_fact: She was a reporting person in the Ades/Erani/Nussdorf founder-family Schedule 13D on Organogenesis, whose shares are counted within her husband Alan Ades's ~17.6% beneficial stake.
notes: Very private: no public profile found beyond SEC filings (signed via attorney-in-fact William R. Kolb). Not an executive; outreach realistically only via the Ades family / Organogenesis. Alive status not confirmed.

name: Liu Chenyan
current_role: Director (former chairman to Apr 2025) and major shareholder, Wangsu Science & Technology (300017.SZ); controls Cloudsway via Fromindo Limited
profile: Liu Chengyan (刘成彦, b. 1964; listed as 'Liu Chenyan') joined CDN/edge-cloud provider Wangsu Science & Technology as COO in 2001, a year after its founding by Chen Baozhen, became its second-largest shareholder and long-time chairman after its 2009 listing. He stepped down as chairman on 7 Apr 2025 for personal reasons, the same day he completed buying Wangsu's 42.3% stake in AI-cloud unit Cloudsway for RMB105.7m.
interesting_fact: In 2025 he personally (via Fromindo Limited) bought Wangsu's 42.2997% stake in Cloudsway Pte. Ltd., a cloud MSP focused on AI model-as-a-service for large-model inference, for RMB105.75m.
deep_cut_fact: A Southeast University graduate, he worked at China Machine Press and the China Association for Science and Technology's management-science research centre, helped set up Beijing Yimai e-mail company, and was COO of China Wanwang (HiChina) in 1999-2000 before joining Wangsu.
notes: Highly relevant to data-center/edge-cloud theme (CDN, edge computing, AI inference cloud via Cloudsway). Times Weekly reports he bought an 18% Wangsu stake in 2005 for RMB1.8m (https://m.163.com/dy/article/JV2KQS900519APGA.html). Current director status after 2025 not re-verified.

name: The Oughtred family
current_role: Family owners of William Jackson Food Group (Hessle, Hull); family on board incl. Chairwoman Sonya Eastaugh and NEDs Nicholas, Mark and Patrick Oughtred
profile: The Oughtreds are the descendant family behind William Jackson Food Group, a sixth-generation Hull food business founded in 1851. The group sold Aunt Bessie's and now owns Abel & Cole, Jacksons Bakery, Belazu (incl. Miso Tasty), Lottie Shaw's and Wellocks. Nicholas Oughtred chaired it for 16 years until 2022; family shareholder Sonya Eastaugh is chairwoman, with CEO Paul Murphy since April 2025.
interesting_fact: Founder William Jackson opened his first shop in 1851 on his wedding day; the company later pioneered horse-drawn deliveries (1908) and a travelling shop (1952), and seventh-generation shareholders are now taking an active role.
deep_cut_fact: Sixth-generation family director Mark Oughtred, a non-executive on the group board with a background in fresh-produce and horticulture marketing, also serves as a Special Constable.
notes: A family, not one person: pick a spokesperson (Chairwoman Sonya Eastaugh or Nicholas Oughtred). HQ: The Riverside Building, Livingstone Road, Hessle HU13 0DZ (business address). Site blocks scripted access; email on site is obfuscated.

name: Zhang Chongyu
current_role: Chairman and Party Secretary, Jinyu Bio-Technology Co. (生物股份, 600201.SH), Hohhot, Inner Mongolia
profile: Zhang Chongyu (张翀宇, b. 1954) has led Jinyu Bio-Technology, a Hohhot-based maker of veterinary biological products, since 1993, as chairman and president until 2019 and chairman since. Hurun lists the fortune jointly with Zhang Jing, the company's vice-chairman and president.
interesting_fact: He has chaired the same company for more than 30 years (since March 1993) and has received the national May Day Labour Medal and National Model Worker honours.
deep_cut_fact: Before vaccines he spent 1976-1993 at Hohhot Metal Materials Company, rising from business-section chief to general manager; he holds a postgraduate degree and is a senior economist.
notes: Company 2024 annual report confirms him as chairman/party secretary since 2019 (chairman since 1993). Company describes its business as R&D, production and sale of veterinary biologics.

name: Zhao Yihong
current_role: Co-founder, Chairman, Executive Director and Chief Strategy Officer, Besunyen Holdings (0926.HK)
profile: Zhao Yihong (赵一弘) founded Beijing Outsell (北京澳特舒尔) in 2000, pioneering mass-market functional health teas in China, and took parent Besunyen Holdings public in Hong Kong. He remains chairman; his wife Gao Yan is co-founder and vice-chairman. In June 2025 he was named chair of the board's strategic investment committee.
interesting_fact: Before starting his tea company he spent 1991-2000 at Tingyi International (Master Kong) in its Tianjin office, rising from salesman to deputy manager for the North China beverage business.
deep_cut_fact: He graduated in economics in 1988 from the China Coal Economics College (now Shandong Technology and Business University), then worked as an officer at the Jinan Municipal Grain Bureau in Shandong (1988-1991); in 2006 he completed a China new-business-leaders programme run with Stanford's professional development centre.

public_contacts.value: besunyen@wsfg.hk (Besunyen IR, handled by Wonderful Sky Financial Group)

notes: Hurun listing only in 2011. IR contact is via the agency route.

name: Shi Xiuyou
current_role: Co-actual controller of Zhejiang Taihua New Material Group (603055.SH); director of controlling shareholder Fuhua Global (福華環球有限公司)
profile: Shi Xiuyou (施秀幼), a Hong Kong national, is joint actual controller of Shanghai-listed Taihua New Material together with her younger brother, chairman Shi Qingdao. Taihua, based in Jiaxing, Zhejiang, makes nylon (polyamide 6/66) filament yarn, greige fabric and finished fabrics. She holds her stake through Fuhua Global, of which she is director and legal representative.
interesting_fact: The company's 2025 annual report names her and her brother Shi Qingdao as the group's ultimate controllers ('施秀幼、施清岛姐弟'), a sister-and-brother partnership in nylon textiles.
notes: Non-executive, low profile; brother Shi Qingdao (chairman) is the public face. Route via company board office.

name: Bruce Craig
current_role: Owner (50:50 with Sir James Dyson since March 2026) and head of Bath Rugby; former CEO/chairman of pharma logistics firm Marken
profile: Bristol-born Bruce Craig (b. 1962) joined pharmaceutical/clinical-trial logistics company Marken as a graduate, became CEO in 1999 and led a series of buyouts before Apax bought it for £975m in 2009; he kept a minority stake and became non-exec chairman. He bought Bath Rugby outright in 2010 and in 2026 brought in Sir James Dyson as an equal partner while continuing to run the club and its new-stadium plans.
interesting_fact: On selling half of Bath Rugby to Sir James Dyson in March 2026 he said: 'This has never been a short term project,' adding he would keep running the club and deliver the new stadium.
deep_cut_fact: A Loughborough Sport and Business Management graduate, he captained St Brendan's College 1st XV, missed an England U19 trial with a broken leg, and played for French club Racing Club de France from 1987 to 1993 after moving to Paris.
notes: Best route is via Bath Rugby media office. Good entrepreneurship story (graduate trainee to CEO, £975m exit).

name: Fan Xiane
current_role: Chairman, legal representative and actual controller, Kunming Longjin Pharmaceutical Co. (龙津药业; now traded as 龙津5, 400270)
profile: Fan Xiane (樊献俄) is chairman and actual controller (via Kunming Qunxing Investment) of Kunming Longjin Pharmaceutical, founded in 1996, which develops and makes modern traditional Chinese medicines and specialty chemical generics. The company listed in Shenzhen (002750) and, after delisting, has traded on the NEEQ delisted-companies board since 8 Aug 2025; he still signs its 2025 annual report as head.
interesting_fact: Longjin is based in Kunming's high-tech zone and has been recognised as a national 'specialised and sophisticated' (专精特新) 'little giant' enterprise.
notes: Hurun listing only 2015-2016; company was delisted from SZSE in 2025 after losses, so current wealth likely far below list figure. No personal biography found.

name: Perry A Sook
current_role: Chairman and CEO, Nexstar Media Group, Inc. (NASDAQ: NXST)
profile: Perry Sook (b. c.1958, DuBois, PA) founded Nexstar in 1996 with a single TV station, WYOU in Scranton, after selling Superior Communication Group to Sinclair, and took it public in 2003. Through the Media General (2017) and Tribune (2019) deals it became the largest US local broadcaster: with partners ~265 stations in 132 markets, plus NewsNation, 81% of The CW and 31% of Food Network. He chaired the NAB Joint Board 2023-25.
interesting_fact: Named Broadcasting & Cable's 2009 Broadcaster of the Year and inducted into the B&C Hall of Fame in 2014; he has 45+ years in broadcasting and sits on the NAB and Broadcasters Foundation of America boards.
deep_cut_fact: His first sales job was at a small radio station in Kissimmee, Florida, which failed to pay his commission after he landed a big ad sale, prompting his move into TV sales. Early on he also did radio sales and on-air work at WPME AM/FM in Punxsutawney, PA, and was an adjunct professor at Edinboro State University.
notes: Punxsutawney/WPME detail confirmed by NY State Broadcasters Hall of Fame bio (https://halloffame.nysbroadcasters.org/post/perry-sook). Route via Nexstar corporate communications.

name: Huang Ruoqing
current_role: Executive Director and President, Redco Properties Group (1622.HK); non-executive chairman of Redco Healthy Living (2370.HK)
profile: Huang Ruoqing (黄若青) is president and executive director of Redco Properties, the Chinese property developer founded in 1992 by his elder brother, chairman Wong Yeuk Hung (黄若虹). He joined in 1994, oversees day-to-day operations, land acquisition and project planning, and since 2021 chairs the group's listed property-services arm, Redco Healthy Living.
interesting_fact: He has 25+ years in Chinese real estate and has run the family developer's operations alongside his brother since joining in May 1994.
deep_cut_fact: He is a trained architect: after earning a B.Arch from Huaqiao University in July 1990, he worked at the Quanzhou Architectural Design Institute as a designer, assistant architect and project manager until 1994.
notes: No published contact found (Redco sites returned no emails). Route via Redco Properties company secretary/IR per HKEX filings. Positions per 10jqka data; latest status not re-verified against 2026 HKEX filings.

name: Guo Shaoyan
current_role: Former co-controlling shareholder (with Zhuo Chuguang) of Guangdong DP Co. / Jiuliang (久量股份, 300808.SZ); control passed to Shiyan SASAC vehicle in 2024
profile: Guo Shaoyan (郭少燕) was, with Zhuo Chuguang and family members acting in concert, controlling shareholder of Guangdong DP (久量股份), a Shenzhen-listed (300808) maker of LED lighting products. In 2024 they sold stakes and waived voting rights so that Shiyan state-owned vehicle Zhongda Huixiang became controlling shareholder, with Shiyan SASAC as actual controller.
interesting_fact: The 2024 deal transferred control of the LED company from its founding family to the Shiyan (Hubei) municipal SASAC, with the first transfer of 11.42% registered on 2 July 2024.
notes: Hurun listing only 2020. After the 2024 deal she waived voting rights on her remaining ~11.18% stake. No personal profile found; low-value outreach target.

name: You Yizhu
current_role: Co-actual controller of Chongqing Pharscin Pharmaceutical (华森制药, 002907.SZ) via its controlling shareholder Chengdu Dijian, which he controls
profile: You Yizhu (游谊竹) is one of three joint actual controllers of Chongqing Pharscin Pharmaceutical, alongside his brother, chairman You Hongtao, and Wang Ying; he controls Chengdu Dijian, the company's controlling shareholder. Pharscin makes generic and TCM drugs in digestive, neuro-psychiatric and ENT fields and is pushing into innovative drugs.
interesting_fact: Pharscin's affiliate Huasen Aorui is developing ORIC-1940, described by the company as the world's first RIPK1 inhibitor approved for clinical trials in HLH (haemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis), now in multicentre Phase Ib.
notes: Not an executive; brother You Hongtao (chairman) is the public face. No personal biography found. Route via Pharscin IR.

name: Xiang Bin
current_role: Chairman and actual controller, Guangzhou Well Lead Medical Co. (维力医疗, 603309.SH)
profile: Xiang Bin (向彬, b. 1969, Hong Kong resident) has chaired Guangzhou Well Lead Medical since 2011 and is its actual controller via controlling shareholder Gaobo Investment. The Panyu, Guangzhou-based company makes medical consumables, including anaesthesia-related devices, and has been recognised as a manufacturing 'single champion' product enterprise.
interesting_fact: Well Lead has been named a national manufacturing 'single champion' product enterprise and a 'hidden champion', per its company profile.
deep_cut_fact: Before building a medical-device business he studied mathematics, earning his bachelor's degree from Lanzhou University; he later took an EMBA at CEIBS.
notes: Bio from third-party data site (updated 2023), not re-verified against 2025 annual report. Controlling-shareholder status per IPO-era filing (https://pdf.dfcfw.com/pdf/H2_AN201502090008329277_1.pdf). Contact email is a named staff address listed as company contact; verify in latest annual report before use.
